verdict.rationale: Mistral Document AI returns its results in open formats: Markdown text, Markdown or HTML tables, and structured JSON annotations against a user-supplied schema. Its single-container on-prem deployment option also limits lock-in. However, the evidence does not cover bulk export of data stored on the platform (uploaded files, batch outputs, account data) or a documented exit or deletion path. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all stored user data, an account and data deletion process, and independent corroboration of portability.
